text:
ryan: Heads up — I sketched a new Grafana dashboard request for allocatable vs used GPU resources + fragmentation and daily rollups. Need eyes from infra and SRE before I paste panels.

ryan: Goal: help ops spot tenants that fragment VRAM and cause cold-start memory pressure, and correlate with power capping events. Also daily rollup to track waste for capacity planning.

jonah: SGTM. Can you add a small panel for PageCache churn? last week we had a node oom that looked like cache thrash.

ryan: Yup — planning a trend panel for node:pagecache:rss_bytes and a heatmap for per-pod memory delta.

maria: Important: include a panel that shows allocatable GPUs vs assigned containers (not just utilization) — we keep hitting scheduling weirdness where allocatable != free because of pinned KV caches.

ryan: Exactly. I want one panel: per-node allocatable_gpus - sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests_gpu) to show headroom.

ryan: Draft PromQL for headroom: 
```
sum by(node) (kube_node_status_capacity_gpu) - sum by(node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests_gpu)
```

tasha: For fragmentation, maybe a derived metric: percent of allocated VRAM that is idle > 30m. e.g., detect long-lived but low-access allocations.

ryan: I'm thinking: track nvml_active_bytes vs nvml_reserved_bytes and plot ratio. PromQL: 
```
sum by(node) (nvml_reserved_bytes - nvml_active_bytes) / sum by(node) (nvml_reserved_bytes) * 100
```

maria: Add a panel for power events too. We should overlay node power_limit_watts and pdu_trips. Help correlate throttling with fragmentation.

jonah: For alerting, what thresholds? 1) headroom < 1 GPU on >=2 racks for 10m, 2) fragmentation > 40% across >30% of fleet for 15m?

ryan: Proposed alerts: 
- High fragmentation: fragmentation_ratio > 35% in >25% of nodes for 15m
- Scheduler headroom low: headroom_per_node <= 0 for >=3 nodes in region for 10m
- PageCache churn: node:pagecache:write_bytes rate > X and memory delta > Y

sre-ops: Please include runbook links in each alert and a quick mitigation step: `node-shed` to drain and `nvcleanup` to free pinned caches.

ryan: Will add runbook anchors. Also adding an incident panel that points to the deploy/bump quantization playbook for emergency reclaim.

maria: UX note: set the heatmap buckets to minutes (5m) for churn and 1h for fragmentation. Add region filter at top.

tasha: Any concerns about Prom scrape costs? Adding per-pod heatmaps for every node could be expensive. Maybe sample or use relabeling to only export nvml for noisy nodes.

ryan: Good call. I'll add a `nvml_exporter` relabel rule: `node_exporter_nvml_enabled{node=~".*-gpu.*"}` and a recording rule to compress time-series for long-term.

jonah: Can you paste the panel JSON for the fragmentation heatmap when ready? I'll review thresholds and convert to an alert rule in repo.

ryan: Pasting minimal panel snippet below (WIP):
```json
{"type":"heatmap","title":"GPU fragmentation ratio","targets":[{"expr":"sum by(node) (nvml_reserved_bytes - nvml_active_bytes) / sum by(node) (nvml_reserved_bytes) * 100","refId":"A"}],"options":{"bucketSize":"5m"}}
```

maria: 👍 looks good. Once you push the dashboard JSON to grafana/dashboards repo, please open PR and tag `@eng-infra` and `@sre-ops`.

ryan: Will do. Plan: build dashboard in staging grafana, run it for 48h, then promote. I'll also add a synthetic test that simulates a pinned allocation to validate fragmentation metric.

infra-bot: Reminder — dashboard PR checklist: JSON schema validated, variables documented, panel IDs stable, and recorder rules referenced.

tasha: One last ask: add a cost panel that estimates wasted vRAM in GB-hours and translates to monthly $ using `cost_per_gb_hour` var. Helps product justify reserved capacity.

ryan: Nice. I'll include a derived series: `sum(node_wasted_vram_bytes) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 * 24 * 30 * $cost_per_gb_hour`.

jonah: Great thread — thanks. Ping when PR is up and I will wire the alerting rules. :thumbsup:
